label: VERIFIED
extraction: Verification Loop phase commands and reporting format. Phase 1 Build: npm run build / pnpm build - if fails STOP. Phase 2 Type Check: npx --no-install tsc --noEmit / pyright - report all type errors, fix critical. Phase 3 Lint: npm run lint / ruff check. Phase 4 Test: npm run test -- --coverage - target 80% minimum, report total/passed/failed/coverage%. Phase 5 Security: grep -rn "sk-" / "api_key" / "console.log" in source files. Phase 6 Diff Review: git diff --stat, git diff HEAD~1 --name-only - review for unintended changes, missing error handling, edge cases. Output: VERIFICATION REPORT with PASS/FAIL per phase, overall READY/NOT READY. Issues to Fix listed. Continuous mode: run every 15 minutes or after major changes (after each function, component, before next task). Run: /verify.
